timing: Registered after the 61-question seven-window retrospective matched residual calibration scored .55649 and the per-window bounded same-direction hindsight ceiling reached .57523, versus a shrink-only ceiling of .55693 and unrestricted-sign bounded ceiling of .57618. These are opportunity diagnostics. Use subsequent wholly unexposed windows to distinguish prospective performance. No independent test labels enter design.
fit: For each outer held H, stage and one deleted donor D from the other five, drop BOTH entire histories before fitting the raw/verified pair-ridge predictors, scaling their features and calibrating the residual slope. Re-estimate both true and rotated gamma with still deeper leave-one-history-out prediction on the remaining four histories; each deepest fit has three histories. Apply these five models to the same current-source structural features. Each deletion vote is in physical F1 units, centered only on its actual remaining donors. On a new independent target exclude no training history and delete each of the six donors once.
policy: One vote is +1 for a score at least +.01 F1, -1 for at most -.01 and 0 otherwise. Add twice the mean vote to the repaired raw-return logit. Main scores are raw + nested gamma times verified credit. The raw-rank consensus uses only raw, the placebo consensus rotates the same within-stratum credits and calibrates its own gamma. Compare the unmodified residual-calibrated actor, a single full-fold hard vote at the same threshold, unanimous-only shifts, and bounded smooth votes tanh(score/.025). These thresholds and logit bounds stay fixed. The primary test requires improvement against the same consensus trained without credit. Retain five donor-deletion votes and raw/rotated controls for every stage and source. Distinguish probability changes attributable to credit from changes attributable to the voting policy alone.
evaluation: Apply unchanged full-coverage 40 later window/378 question, 99 prefix endpoint/185 question and exact-replica/strict gates. Require +.02 expected F1 and positive HT over native and terminal, positives over raw anchor, matched rate, raw-only consensus, rotated consensus and parent residual actor. Expanded also beats original consensus. Keep held-history coverage, costs, uncertainty and the independent development and locked test boundaries.
